name: Tidy
description: Hide the icons on your Desktop with one click, and show them again with another.
author: Giuseppe
details: Hide the icons on your Desktop with one click, for a clean screen when you share or record it, and show them again with another. The files stay where they are. They come back by themselves when Notcholino quits.
features: One switch to hide or show the icons
Icons come back when the app quits
permissions: Finder restarts for a second to apply the change.
